value.name: felix confronts wren
value.description: Felix approaches Wren at his market stall, initiating a direct confrontation.
evidence: Felix approaches Wren at his stall. Wren looks unsurprised.

value.name: wren says he expected felix
value.description: Wren reveals he anticipated Felix's arrival, suggesting prior awareness of the conflict.
evidence:
WREN
Master Adler. I expected you eventually.

value.name: felix demands map back
value.description: Felix states his purpose plainly by demanding the return of his map.
evidence:
FELIX
I want my map back.

value.name: wren denies possessing map
value.description: Wren denies having the map and defends himself by citing his earlier attempt to buy it openly.
evidence:
WREN
(spreading his hands)
I do not have it.

FELIX
You offered to buy it.

WREN
I offered five hundred gold coins and you refused me. Plainly and publicly. That was the end of my interest. Why would I steal what I tried to purchase through honest negotiation?

value.name: felix accuses wren of motive
value.description: Felix argues that Wren would steal the map because he knew Felix would never sell it.
evidence:
FELIX
Because you knew I would never sell.

value.name: sable joins confrontation
value.description: Sable arrives beside Felix, bringing her satchel into the scene and drawing Wren's attention.
evidence: SABLE arrives beside Felix. She carries her LEATHER SATCHEL over one shoulder.

value.name: sable fastens satchel shut
value.description: Sable visibly closes her leather satchel with a firm brass clasp, establishing that it is secured.
evidence: She reaches up and fastens it shut with its BRASS CLASP -- a firm, clean click.

value.name: wren notes sable was cleared
value.description: Wren acknowledges hearing that Sable was cleared, and Sable confirms it.
evidence:
WREN
(eyeing Sable)
Your apprentice. I heard she was cleared.

value.name: felix notices satchel at stall entrance
value.description: As he turns to leave, Felix sees Sable's satchel sitting full and intact near Wren's stall entrance, contradicting the image of it being on her shoulder moments earlier.
evidence: Felix turns to leave and notices, near the ENTRANCE of Wren's stall, Sable's leather satchel sitting on the ground -- full, buckled, intact. He pauses.

value.name: sable explains satchel placement
value.description: When Felix points out the satchel, Sable explains that she set it down while looking at the next stall.
evidence:
FELIX
(quietly, to Sable)
Your satchel is there.

SABLE
I set it down when I looked at the next stall.

value.name: felix registers inconsistency
value.description: Felix mentally notes the suspicious satchel discrepancy, indicating growing suspicion or deduction.
